metadata.title: Defense Intelligence cross-surface evidence graph
metadata.authorityBoundary: Deterministic public-source joins only. Exact IDs and source-declared relationships are authoritative; normalized-label and account-title joins are explicitly derived and never presented as universal federal crosswalks.

identityRules.activity: Stable opportunityId across procurement discovery, map, timeline, analytics, tracking, and agent records.
identityRules.award: USAspending generated award ID; PIID is retained as an alias.
identityRules.organization: Published UEI for recipients and reviewed office code for contracting offices take precedence. Unique normalized-label joins to a published UEI remain derived; ambiguous labels remain separate and queued for review. No fuzzy entity merge.
identityRules.organizationIdentifier: Typed public identifier entity. UEI and reviewed office-code claims retain their source artifact and join basis; CAGE remains empty until published evidence enters the corpus.
identityRules.location: Stable reviewed location ID from the authoritative map snapshot.
identityRules.federalAccount: Federal account code from USAspending account spine.

evidenceRules.exact: Stable source identifier or exact public relationship.
evidenceRules.reviewed: Human-reviewed source relationship from the installation/location evidence layer.
evidenceRules.source_declared: Role or label explicitly published by the source artifact.
evidenceRules.deterministic: Repeatable classification or projection from retained source fields.
evidenceRules.derived: Useful deterministic join that remains labeled non-authoritative, such as an exact normalized account-title match.

precedence: unique normalized label to a single published UEI
organizationIdentityPolicy.conflictRule: A normalized label published with multiple UEIs never merges those legal entities; it remains a review queue item.
organizationIdentityPolicy.aliasRule: Multiple public labels sharing one exact UEI are retained as aliases of the UEI-canonical entity.
organizationIdentityPolicy.hierarchyRule: Parent-child edges come only from retained source-declared acquisition paths and remain source-declared rather than legal-corporate claims.
